tools.name: best_in_category
tools.description: Answers "what is the best / most popular / most used X". Returns a one-sentence answer, the #1 and #2, the cheapest product in the top five, the fastest riser, the top 10, the sources the estimate is based on and the page URL. Shares are estimated % of builds/purchases. Optional region, brand ("AMD"

tools.name: get_ranking
tools.description: The ranked list for one category and month: estimated share of builds/purchases, change in percentage points vs the previous month, rank last month, US price, and the sources behind it. Optional region.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find products by name, e.g. "9800X3D", "RTX 5070", "Superlight". Returns ids and names to use with get_product and compare_products.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product: its rank and share in each category it appears in, 12-month share history, and prices by region with shop links. Accepts an id or a name.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Side-by-side popularity, trend and US price for 2 to 5 products, e.g. ["RTX 5070", "RX 9070 XT"].

tools.name: trending
tools.description: Products that gained or lost the most share this month, across all categories or one section (pc, peripherals, laptops).

tools.name: meta_build
tools.description: The #1 product in every category of a section put together, with the total US price. pc = a full PC build, peripherals = the full desk setup.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category Ask Bestie Computers ranks, with ids, search names, filters and page URLs, plus the months available.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_categories · Public sink: get_ranking, get_product, trending.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_categories · Public sink: get_ranking, get_product, trending

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
